 We are currently seeking to employ a talented and highly-motivated “ Junior Data Analyst ” to join our Anytime Romania team .
 Purpose: 
 Collect, prepare & analyze the data helping the business facilitate effective & data driven decision making.
 Key Responsibilities: 
Discusses business questions, identifies and agrees upon all the steps in the analysis needed and the timeline. 
Assesses and explores data from all possible sources and prepares data for further data usage. Identifies valuable data sources and automates collection processes. Processes, cleanses, and verifies the integrity of data used for analysis. 
Interprets and visualizes data, analyzes results using statistical techniques and provides ongoing reports. 
Presents the analysis or modeling results and approaches clearly to business owners. 
 Knowledge & experience: 
BSc in Mathematics/ Statistics/Economics/Analytics/Operational Research or in similar fields.
Intermediate knowledge of English Language.
Basic knowledge of statistical packages (Python, SQL, SAS), knowledge of and experience with reporting packages (Power BI, Tableau etc.).
Knowledge of Microsoft Azure Databricks will be considered a plus
0-2 years of working experience.
 Competencies: 
Customer focus
Collaboration
Self – development
Ensures accountability
Business insight
Communicates effectively
Financial acumen
Courage
 What We Offer: 
Occupational Pension Fund, with a monthly company contribution of 6,25% of gross monthly salary.
Regina Maria Health Subscription
Hybrid working model (two days in the office and three days working from home) 
Monthly meal vouchers
Continuous learning via Udemy platform and development opportunities.
A collaborative, inclusive, and people-centric working environment.
 Please note: The salary range for this role will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process upon request.
